release_notes: Renames the root interface to Mainkill1's Test Suite.
Restores a ten-second no-input autorun countdown.
Adds eight ordered ZPASS report-query leaves with terminal-semaphore completion and structured report-memory evidence.
Hardens the DMA descriptor-rewrite, complete-record bounds, per-leaf state, teardown, and failure-description contracts.
known_issues: The DMA descriptor-rewrite and range-guard leaves are xemu-only pending physical Xbox characterization.
A synchronous renderer may report completed_before_rewrite instead of pending_cross; both modes require complete A1/B0 records and an untouched B1 sentinel.
